types.explanation: Extended HELLO command used to identify the client and request server capabilities.
Basic HELLO command used to identify the client when EHLO is not supported.
Initiates a mail transaction, specifying the sender (reverse-path).
Identifies an individual recipient (forward-path) for the mail transaction.
Initiates transfer of the mail data (message content).
Resets the current mail transaction, discarding stored data.
No operation; requests a '250 OK' reply without affecting state.
Terminates the SMTP session after receiving a '221 OK' reply.
Verifies that a user or mailbox exists.
Expands a mailing list, returning its members.
Requests help information from the server.
